cohort: Pregnant patients admitted during the latent phase of labor (<6 cm cervical dilatation) who delivered neonates with birthweight >= 4,000 g and underwent amniotomy during labor.
finding: In pregnancies with fetal macrosomia, early amniotomy was associated with an increased risk of intrapartum cesarean delivery among women undergoing induction of labor, but not in those with spontaneous labor.
mod_finding: Early amniotomy was associated with an increased risk of intrapartum cesarean delivery among women undergoing induction of labor in pregnancies with fetal macrosomia.
